name: Deferred Reflection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A deferred shading method for rendering specular reflections with 3D Gaussian Splatting. Solves the problem of high-frequency radiance fields being difficult to fit stably and accurately, and the bottleneck of normal estimation caused by discontinuous gradients.
summary: Deferred Reflection in 3D Gaussian Splatting is a two-pass technique that computes specular reflections per-pixel in screen space, separating splatting from shading to enable pixel-precise normal maps and stable optimization.
